name: District of Columbia

statute.name: District of Columbia Freedom of Information Act

response.rule_text: Disclosure or denial is due within 15 days excluding weekends and legal holidays (25 days for body-worn camera recordings), D.C. Code § 2-532(c); unusual circumstances allow up to 10 more such days, § 2-532(d)(1).

fees.labor_rule: Search, review and copying fees cannot exceed actual costs; tiered by requester type (commercial: search, duplication and review; news media/educational: duplication only; others: search and duplication).
fees.copy_rule: Actual cost of copying, D.C. Code § 2-532(b).
fees.waiver_rule: All search and copying fees may be waived or reduced if disclosure primarily benefits the general public, § 2-532(b).

residency.rule_text: Any 'person' may inspect or copy public records, D.C. Code § 2-532(a).

appeal.rule_text: Appeal to the Mayor under D.C. Code § 2-537(a); agency has 5 days to respond and the Mayor 10 days (excl. weekends/holidays) to decide; if the Mayor denies or fails to act within 10 working days, court review is available. Denials by the Council may go directly to court, § 2-537(a-1).
